A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions. Clear answers.

Can you customize a project?+

Yes. Share your idea, required features and deadline. Our team will review feasibility and provide a scoped quote.

Can I buy kits and get them delivered?+

You can enquire about hardware kits and components. Kit contents, availability, delivery location, charges and lead time are confirmed in your quote.

Can schools and colleges place bulk enquiries?+

Yes. Share your component list, quantities and institution details. You can send an Excel or PDF through WhatsApp for review.

Do you build websites and IoT dashboards too?+

Yes. Digital and IoT solutions include websites, applications, sensor dashboards and connected-device integrations. Share your scope to discuss a solution.
